experience.description: Leading a team of 12+ engineers building high-throughput, distributed ingestion systems handling 1B+ daily item, price, and inventory update events. Spearheaded core ingestion platform powering data flows across Store, Online, and Marketplace — contributing to $1B+ in annual revenue through marketplace expansion. Built a GenAI-powered, supplier-native item ingestion framework that seamlessly processes items across diverse data formats into the catalog, eliminating duplication and improving onboarding efficiency. Built the NOF ticket resolution agent, eliminating manual triage for ~3.4K monthly issues and reducing resolution times from 1 week to near real-time. Integrated Generative AI into item setup, increasing content quality from 50% to 90%+ and reducing manual effort from 2 hours to 5 minutes. Developed the Configurable Spec Parser — a metadata-driven onboarding framework that reduced setup time from 2 weeks to 5 minutes, saving ~80 person-days, now used across 7+ major initiatives. Re-architected ingestion pipeline to a reactive, non-blocking model; scaled to handle 500M+ items/day during peak load with full SLA compliance. Recognized with Tech Forward Award by the CTO for exceptional business impact.

Designed an on-demand schema loading system that reduced memory usage by 90% and validation time from 20 minutes to 8 seconds, enabling efficient scaling to support 6,000+ product-type schemas. Built end-to-end real-time validation across ingestion flows, identifying ~100K data errors daily and significantly boosting CSAT scores. Re-architected platform components to support zero-code onboarding of new tenants — enabled  flow in just 2 days with zero production downtime. Consolidated Excel and JSON converters into a Universal Data Mapper used across 10+ initiatives, reducing onboarding time by 70–80%. Built a grammar-based routing engine for feed traffic with zero-code updates in under 5 minutes.

Founding member of Specification Platform team — the backbone of the ingestion platform. Led the initial proof of concept, secured executive sponsorship and funding, and scaled the team to 30+ engineers globally. The platform powered 50+ high-impact initiatives across Store, Online, and Marketplace with a revenue impact in the billions. Architected and built a centralized schema registry from the ground up, reducing onboarding time from 3 weeks to 2 hours and powering 20+ major initiatives. Engineered a dynamic mapping engine that cut onboarding time from 3 weeks to 15 minutes by auto-generating mappings from catalog data flows. Recognized with the prestigious Impact Award from the CTO for exceptional contributions.

Engineered core components for online and store catalog platform, driving migration from a legacy stack to a modern architecture — reduced item setup time from 2+ days to just 4 hours. Implemented Walmart's first automated item spec generation tool, cutting artifact creation time from 5 days to just minutes. Designed and implemented an event-driven compliance pipeline for the item setup system supporting business, ensuring real-time policy enforcement across millions of SKUs.

Implemented robust validation and enrichment services to enhance catalog data quality, driving higher accuracy, completeness, and operational efficiency in item onboarding. Developed a comprehensive analytics module to track key performance metrics such as end-to-end item setup time, error rates, and success rates, enabling data-driven optimization and continuous improvement across the platform.

Developed the Merchandising Center Tool enabling merchants to seamlessly interact with suppliers, streamlining collaboration and improving supply chain visibility. Implemented scalable microservices and built a real-time reporting framework, enhancing data accessibility and decision-making. Built a robust performance test suite ensuring high reliability and system performance at scale.

Led the implementation of the browse e-commerce platform for JCPenney.com using the ATG framework, enhancing site navigation and scalability for millions of users. Developed high-performing product display pages and integrated social media features into the item catalog. Built a product personalization module that dynamically tailored shopping experiences based on user behavior. Implemented multi-level caching strategies with Akamai, significantly improving page load times. Designed and integrated product search functionality leveraging Endeca and third-party web services. Delivered a content management system for Telecharge.com.
